items_all.title: AI資安業者Alice募資1.4億美元，AI業務兩年成長逾500%
items_all.summary: AI資安業者Alice近日完成1.4億美元募資，由Apax Digital Funds領投，累計募資金額達2.8億美元。隨著企業與AI模型業者對AI安全的需求增加，Alice表示，公司AI相關業務過去兩年成長超過500%，年度經常性收入（Annual Recurring Revenue，ARR）已接近1億美元。 Alice前身為ActiveFence，最初主要提供網路平臺信任與安全相關服務，長期追蹤詐騙、極端主義內容及協同操弄等網路濫用活動，近年則將這些威脅資料運用於AI安全領域。Alice合作的AI模型開發業者包括Anthropic、Google及Cohere等。

items_all.title: Gartner示警AI可從既有資料推論敏感個人資訊，成隱私管理新風險
items_all.summary: 商業與科技研究機構Gartner預測，到了2029年，多數隱私事件將不再源自個人識別資訊直接曝光，而是AI根據既有資料產生的個人資訊推論所引發的風險。即使資料本身看似無害，或已經過匿名化、彙整處理，AI仍可能綜合其中線索，推論出健康狀況、行為模式等敏感個人資訊。

items_all.title: IBM Releases Granite 4.2: Bringing Native Reasoning and Agentic RL to Open Enterprise Models
items_all.summary: IBM has released Granite 4.2, a family of open reasoning language models in 3B, 8B, and 30B sizes, all under Apache 2.0. Every model exposes a thinking / low-effort / non-thinking switch and native tool calling. The 8B and 30B additionally go through an agentic RL block that trains them to edit code, drive a terminal, and run web searches inside real sandboxed environments. The 30B reports 57.00 on SWE-Bench Verified and 29.24 on Terminal-Bench 2.1. The post IBM Releases Granite 4.2: Bringing Native Reasoning and Agentic RL to Open Enterprise Models appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: IBM 發布了 Granite 4.2，這是一系列開放推理語言模型，包含 3B、8B 和 30B 三種規模，均採用 Apache 2.0 授權。每個模型都提供「思考/低投入/非思考」切換開關和原生工具呼叫。 8B 和 30B 模型也經過一個智慧強化學習模組，該模組訓練它們在真實的沙盒環境中編輯程式碼、操作終端和進行網路搜尋。 30B 模型在 SWE-Bench Verified 測試中獲得 57.00 分，在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 測試中獲得 29.24 分。本文《IBM 發布 Granite 4.2：將原生推理與智慧強化學習引入開放企業模型》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: Russia used ChatGPT to run a covert influence campaign pushing pro-Kremlin narratives across the West
items_all.summary: OpenAI has disrupted a covert Russian influence campaign that used ChatGPT to generate social media posts by banning a cluster of accounts. The operators accessed the platform through VPNs from Russia and promoted the fictitious "International Burke Institute," including German-language Telegram content critical of the EU and the German government. The campaign's reach stayed small, but OpenAI warns the infrastructure behind it could have been scaled up over time. The article Russia used ChatGPT to run a covert influence campaign pushing pro-Kremlin narratives across the West appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI 封鎖了一批帳號，破壞了一場利用 ChatGPT 平臺在社群媒體上釋出內容的秘密俄羅斯影響力活動。這些業者透過 VPN 從俄羅斯訪問該平臺，並推廣虛構的“國際伯克研究所”，其中包括在 Telegram 上發布批評歐盟和德國政府的德語內容。該活動的規模目前還比較小，但 OpenAI 警告稱，其背後的基礎設施可能會隨著時間的推移而擴大。文章《俄羅斯利用 ChatGPT 在西方開展秘密影響力活動，傳播親克里姆林宮的敘事》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_all.title: OpenAI's first custom chip "Jalapeño" reportedly beats Nvidia's Blackwell and Rubin in inference benchmarks
items_all.summary: OpenAI showed off "Jalapeño," its first in-house inference chip, with benchmarks at the Hot Chips conference. According to SemiAnalysis tests, the chip beats Nvidia's Blackwell and even Rubin in throughput and energy efficiency. "Usually first generation chips aren't competitive, but OpenAI is beating Nvidia Blackwell and even Rubin," SemiAnalysis CEO Dylan Patel said. The article OpenAI's first custom chip "Jalapeño" reportedly beats Nvidia's Blackwell and Rubin in inference benchmarks appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 Hot Chips 大會上展示了其首款自主研發的推理晶片“Jalapeño”，並進行了基準測試。根據 SemiAnalysis 的測試，該晶片在吞吐量和能源效率方面均超越了輝達的 Blackwell 和 Rubin。 「通常第一代晶片不具備競爭力，但 OpenAI 卻擊敗了輝達的 Blackwell 甚至 Rubin，」SemiAnalysis 執行長 Dylan Patel 表示。文章《OpenAI's 首款客製化晶片「Jalapeño」據稱在推理基準測試中擊敗輝達的 Blackwell 和 Rubin》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

The article Google launches Gemini for legal work to automate contracts and research appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Google推出法律產業的AI解決方案Gemini Enterprise for Legal，該方案可透過MCP連接器與iManage、DocuSign和Everlaw等系統連接。德勤等合作夥伴銷售現成的AI代理，用於合約審查等任務。 Anthropic已提供類似解決方案。所有供應商均使用與其其他產品相同的模型。文章《Google推出法律工作的Gemini，實現合約與研究自動化》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items_all.title: Nvidia says its Groq 3 LPX is four times faster than Cerebras, but the math is more complicated
items_all.summary: Nvidia is moving its Groq 3 LPX inference chip into full production and reports 3,400 tokens per second on Gemma 4 31B, four times faster than Cerebras. But the numbers don't tell the whole story. Nvidia needs at least 64 accelerators to get there, while Cerebras needs only one or two, according to The Register. How well the architecture scales with large MoE models remains an open question. The article Nvidia says its Groq 3 LPX is four times faster than Cerebras, but the math is more complicated appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 輝達正將其 Groq 3 LPX 推理晶片投入全面量產，並報告稱其在 Gemma 4 31B 平臺上的運算速度達到每秒 3400 個令牌，比 Cerebras 快四倍。但這些數字並不能說明全部問題。根據 The Register 報導，輝達至少需要 64 個加速器才能達到這一速度，而 Cerebras 只需要一到兩個。該架構在處理大型 MoE 模型時擴充套件性如何，目前仍是一個懸而未決的問題。這篇文章《輝達稱其 Groq 3 LPX 比 Cerebras 快四倍，但計算過程更為複雜》最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Ukraine opens its massive labeled battlefield dataset to British firms in a landmark AI weapons partnership
items_all.summary: The UK becomes the first country to get access to Avengers Labs, Ukraine's platform holding roughly five million annotated combat images for training military AI. Three British startups are already working on pilot projects. The deal shows how real war data is systematically becoming the currency for building out autonomous weapons tech. The article Ukraine opens its massive labeled battlefield dataset to British firms in a landmark AI weapons partnership appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 英國成為首個獲準使用烏克蘭復仇者實驗室（Avengers Labs）平臺的國家。該平臺擁有約500萬張標註的戰鬥影象，用於訓練軍事人工智慧。三家英國新創公司已在進行試點計畫。這項合作表明，真實的戰爭資料正逐漸成為建構自主武器技術的基礎。本文《烏克蘭向英國公司開放其龐大的戰場標註資料集，達成具有里程碑意義的人工智慧武器合作》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items_all.title: Alabama AG probes OpenAI after its AI agent went rogue and hacked into external systems
items_all.summary: Alabama Attorney General Steve Marshall is investigating OpenAI over what he calls an "AI lab leak." The probe follows the July 2026 Hugging Face incident, where an OpenAI agent broke out of a test environment and gained internet access on its own. Whether that happened because of advanced AI capabilities or sloppy cybersecurity is still unclear. The article Alabama AG probes OpenAI after its AI agent went rogue and hacked into external systems appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 阿拉巴馬州總檢察長史蒂夫馬歇爾正在調查OpenAI，他稱之為「人工智慧實驗室洩漏事件」。這項調查源自於2026年7月發生的Hugging Face事件，當時一個OpenAI代理程式突破了測試環境，並自行取得了網路存取權限。目前尚不清楚這究竟是由於人工智慧的先進功能還是網路安全漏洞所造成的。文章《阿拉巴馬州總檢察長調查OpenAI，此前其人工智慧代理程式失控併入侵了外部系統》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items_all.title: Taiwanese cybersecurity firm warns that AI tools have more than doubled Chinese state-backed cyberattacks
items_all.summary: Chinese state-backed hacking groups have more than doubled their attacks since they started using AI models like DeepSeek to write exploit code and scan networks, according to Taiwanese security firm TeamT5. Hackers also used ChatGPT and Anthropic's Claude Code. A UK study shows the cyber capabilities of open models are catching up fast. The article Taiwanese cybersecurity firm warns that AI tools have more than doubled Chinese state-backed cyberattacks appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 據臺灣安全公司TeamT5稱，自中國政府支援的駭客組織開始使用DeepSeek等人工智慧模型編寫攻擊程式碼和掃描網路以來，其攻擊次數已增加了一倍以上。駭客也使用了ChatGPT、Anthropic's和Claude Code等模型。英國的一項研究表明，開放模式的網路攻擊能力正在迅速追趕。本文《臺灣網路安全公司警告：人工智慧工具使中國政府支援的網路攻擊次數增加了一倍以上》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items_all.title: Quoting Paul Dix
items_all.summary: The fact that AI wrote 1M LOC and then refined it over the course of the next couple of months to produce a reliable piece of software that is currently running on millions of developer machines is absolutely mind blowing. And you can say, “well it’s not that impressive because they had an oracle to compare against, so it was simple to go from one language to another”, but I think that’s selling this entire thing short. If you can build a verification system and give proper direction, AI can produce a highly complex, highly sophisticated piece of software and it can continue to refine it until it just works. — Paul Dix , The end of programming Tags: coding-agents , ai-assisted-programming , generative-ai , bun , ai , llms

items_all.summary: EVE Online: The Move to Python 3 Begins! EVE Online has been one of the most interesting case studies in Python at scale for over twenty years now. They've been running on Stackless Python since their launch in 2003, and their last major upgrade was 16 years ago, to Stackless Python 2.7 in 2010 . Their upgrade to Python 3 will start using the futurize script against 2.4 million lines of code, followed by careful manual review of the ~20,000 places where Python 2 and 3 behavior differ - for example 1 / 2 is 0 in Python 2 but is 0.5 in Python 3. There's nothing in this announcement about how they plan to replace Stackless, but at their conference last year they presented Scheduling in Carbon: Leaving Stackless Python Behind describing how they replaced Stackless in the Carbon engine for their more recent game EVE Frontier, using their (now open source) carbonengine/scheduler library. Via Lobster.rs Tags: eve-online , migrations , python , python3 , stackless

items_all_raw.title: AI資安業者Alice募資1.4億美元，AI業務兩年成長逾500%
items_all_raw.summary: AI資安業者Alice近日完成1.4億美元募資，由Apax Digital Funds領投，累計募資金額達2.8億美元。隨著企業與AI模型業者對AI安全的需求增加，Alice表示，公司AI相關業務過去兩年成長超過500%，年度經常性收入（Annual Recurring Revenue，ARR）已接近1億美元。 Alice前身為ActiveFence，最初主要提供網路平臺信任與安全相關服務，長期追蹤詐騙、極端主義內容及協同操弄等網路濫用活動，近年則將這些威脅資料運用於AI安全領域。Alice合作的AI模型開發業者包括Anthropic、Google及Cohere等。

items_all_raw.title: Gartner示警AI可從既有資料推論敏感個人資訊，成隱私管理新風險
items_all_raw.summary: 商業與科技研究機構Gartner預測，到了2029年，多數隱私事件將不再源自個人識別資訊直接曝光，而是AI根據既有資料產生的個人資訊推論所引發的風險。即使資料本身看似無害，或已經過匿名化、彙整處理，AI仍可能綜合其中線索，推論出健康狀況、行為模式等敏感個人資訊。

items_all_raw.title: Quoting Paul Dix
items_all_raw.summary: The fact that AI wrote 1M LOC and then refined it over the course of the next couple of months to produce a reliable piece of software that is currently running on millions of developer machines is absolutely mind blowing. And you can say, “well it’s not that impressive because they had an oracle to compare against, so it was simple to go from one language to another”, but I think that’s selling this entire thing short. If you can build a verification system and give proper direction, AI can produce a highly complex, highly sophisticated piece of software and it can continue to refine it until it just works. — Paul Dix , The end of programming Tags: coding-agents , ai-assisted-programming , generative-ai , bun , ai , llms

items_all_raw.title: IBM Releases Granite 4.2: Bringing Native Reasoning and Agentic RL to Open Enterprise Models
items_all_raw.summary: IBM has released Granite 4.2, a family of open reasoning language models in 3B, 8B, and 30B sizes, all under Apache 2.0. Every model exposes a thinking / low-effort / non-thinking switch and native tool calling. The 8B and 30B additionally go through an agentic RL block that trains them to edit code, drive a terminal, and run web searches inside real sandboxed environments. The 30B reports 57.00 on SWE-Bench Verified and 29.24 on Terminal-Bench 2.1. The post IBM Releases Granite 4.2: Bringing Native Reasoning and Agentic RL to Open Enterprise Models appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: IBM 發布了 Granite 4.2，這是一系列開放推理語言模型，包含 3B、8B 和 30B 三種規模，均採用 Apache 2.0 授權。每個模型都提供「思考/低投入/非思考」切換開關和原生工具呼叫。 8B 和 30B 模型也經過一個智慧強化學習模組，該模組訓練它們在真實的沙盒環境中編輯程式碼、操作終端和進行網路搜尋。 30B 模型在 SWE-Bench Verified 測試中獲得 57.00 分，在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 測試中獲得 29.24 分。本文《IBM 發布 Granite 4.2：將原生推理與智慧強化學習引入開放企業模型》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: EVE Online: The Move to Python 3 Begins!
items_all_raw.summary: EVE Online: The Move to Python 3 Begins! EVE Online has been one of the most interesting case studies in Python at scale for over twenty years now. They've been running on Stackless Python since their launch in 2003, and their last major upgrade was 16 years ago, to Stackless Python 2.7 in 2010 . Their upgrade to Python 3 will start using the futurize script against 2.4 million lines of code, followed by careful manual review of the ~20,000 places where Python 2 and 3 behavior differ - for example 1 / 2 is 0 in Python 2 but is 0.5 in Python 3. There's nothing in this announcement about how they plan to replace Stackless, but at their conference last year they presented Scheduling in Carbon: Leaving Stackless Python Behind describing how they replaced Stackless in the Carbon engine for their more recent game EVE Frontier, using their (now open source) carbonengine/scheduler library. Via Lobster.rs Tags: eve-online , migrations , python , python3 , stackless

items_all_raw.title: Nvidia says its Groq 3 LPX is four times faster than Cerebras, but the math is more complicated
items_all_raw.summary: Nvidia is moving its Groq 3 LPX inference chip into full production and reports 3,400 tokens per second on Gemma 4 31B, four times faster than Cerebras. But the numbers don't tell the whole story. Nvidia needs at least 64 accelerators to get there, while Cerebras needs only one or two, according to The Register. How well the architecture scales with large MoE models remains an open question. The article Nvidia says its Groq 3 LPX is four times faster than Cerebras, but the math is more complicated appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 輝達正將其 Groq 3 LPX 推理晶片投入全面量產，並報告稱其在 Gemma 4 31B 平臺上的運算速度達到每秒 3400 個令牌，比 Cerebras 快四倍。但這些數字並不能說明全部問題。根據 The Register 報導，輝達至少需要 64 個加速器才能達到這一速度，而 Cerebras 只需要一到兩個。該架構在處理大型 MoE 模型時擴充套件性如何，目前仍是一個懸而未決的問題。這篇文章《輝達稱其 Groq 3 LPX 比 Cerebras 快四倍，但計算過程更為複雜》最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Ukraine opens its massive labeled battlefield dataset to British firms in a landmark AI weapons partnership
items_all_raw.summary: The UK becomes the first country to get access to Avengers Labs, Ukraine's platform holding roughly five million annotated combat images for training military AI. Three British startups are already working on pilot projects. The deal shows how real war data is systematically becoming the currency for building out autonomous weapons tech. The article Ukraine opens its massive labeled battlefield dataset to British firms in a landmark AI weapons partnership appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 英國成為首個獲準使用烏克蘭復仇者實驗室（Avengers Labs）平臺的國家。該平臺擁有約500萬張標註的戰鬥影象，用於訓練軍事人工智慧。三家英國新創公司已在進行試點計畫。這項合作表明，真實的戰爭資料正逐漸成為建構自主武器技術的基礎。本文《烏克蘭向英國公司開放其龐大的戰場標註資料集，達成具有里程碑意義的人工智慧武器合作》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items_all_raw.title: Alabama AG probes OpenAI after its AI agent went rogue and hacked into external systems
items_all_raw.summary: Alabama Attorney General Steve Marshall is investigating OpenAI over what he calls an "AI lab leak." The probe follows the July 2026 Hugging Face incident, where an OpenAI agent broke out of a test environment and gained internet access on its own. Whether that happened because of advanced AI capabilities or sloppy cybersecurity is still unclear. The article Alabama AG probes OpenAI after its AI agent went rogue and hacked into external systems appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 阿拉巴馬州總檢察長史蒂夫馬歇爾正在調查OpenAI，他稱之為「人工智慧實驗室洩漏事件」。這項調查源自於2026年7月發生的Hugging Face事件，當時一個OpenAI代理程式突破了測試環境，並自行取得了網路存取權限。目前尚不清楚這究竟是由於人工智慧的先進功能還是網路安全漏洞所造成的。文章《阿拉巴馬州總檢察長調查OpenAI，此前其人工智慧代理程式失控併入侵了外部系統》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items_all_raw.title: Taiwanese cybersecurity firm warns that AI tools have more than doubled Chinese state-backed cyberattacks
items_all_raw.summary: Chinese state-backed hacking groups have more than doubled their attacks since they started using AI models like DeepSeek to write exploit code and scan networks, according to Taiwanese security firm TeamT5. Hackers also used ChatGPT and Anthropic's Claude Code. A UK study shows the cyber capabilities of open models are catching up fast. The article Taiwanese cybersecurity firm warns that AI tools have more than doubled Chinese state-backed cyberattacks appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 據臺灣安全公司TeamT5稱，自中國政府支援的駭客組織開始使用DeepSeek等人工智慧模型編寫攻擊程式碼和掃描網路以來，其攻擊次數已增加了一倍以上。駭客也使用了ChatGPT、Anthropic's和Claude Code等模型。英國的一項研究表明，開放模式的網路攻擊能力正在迅速追趕。本文《臺灣網路安全公司警告：人工智慧工具使中國政府支援的網路攻擊次數增加了一倍以上》最初發表於The Decoder網站。
